title: AnimationPlayer: Error opening the scene after overriding animation libraries loaded
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible: 4.7, 4.6.3 Not reproducible: 4.5.2 ### System information Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 03 Jul 2026 23:25:36 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 610.43.02) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.36 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description I was trying to override an `AnimationPlayer` node's animation list from outside the scene (e.g., inheriting from the scene, or instantiating the scene and enabling Editable Children). Editing was okay. But it errors when I close & reopen the scene. This happens since 4.6. Godot 4.5 was okay. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create an AnimationLibrary resource and save it as `res://demo.tres` 2. Create a new scene `base.tscn`, add an `AnimationPlayer` node, and load `demo.tres` as the Global library. The Manage Animations dialog should look like this: In the Animation editor, animations are listed without prefix, e.g., `hello`. 3. In another scene, edit the `AnimationPlayer` node from `base.tscn` 1. Create a new scene `instance.tscn`, instance `base.tscn` and enable "Editable Children". 2. Create a new scene `extend.tscn` by inheriting from `base.tscn`. 4. Remove the Global library and load `demo.tres` as its own library. The Manage Animations dialog should look like this: In the Animation editor, animations are listed with the `demo` prefix, e.g., `demo/hello`. 5. Save and close the scene. 6. Open the scene again. - Expected: Everything is fine, the same as before closing the scene. - Actual: Errors. The `AnimationPlayer` looks like it was not overridden at all. > ERROR: Can't add animation library twice (adding as 'demo', exists as ''. p.s. Minor error: the error message is missing a closing parenthesis. _Update:_ A simpler version of the bug: Just remove the inherited Global library in the Edit Animation Libraries dialog. Save the scene and reopen. You can see the AnimationPlayer is still showing the original animations, as if nothing was removed. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [bad_4.7.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29837119/bad_4.7.zip) [good_4.5.2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29837118/good_4.5.2.zip)
